title: Rotate the FTP deploy password exposed in a session transcript
description:
On 2026-11-18 `scripts/deploy.sh --dry-run` printed lftp's planned transfers as ftp://user:password@host URLs. The production FTP password reached a Claude Code session transcript, which the nightly claude-session-backup archives to ~/Backups/claude-code and the LaCie. Local log files were redacted; the transcript and its backups were not.

The script now masks those URLs (commit 2155dce), so this cannot recur through deploy.sh.

To do: change the FTP account password in DirectAdmin, then put the new value where the deploy reads it. Edit .env.deploy in an editor outside any Claude session, or do this together with the Keychain move (see the related bead) so the new password goes straight to Keychain.
acceptance_criteria: Old password no longer accepted by the FTP server; npm run deploy:dry-run connects with the new one and its output shows ://***@ instead of credentials.

title: Move the FTP deploy password from .env.deploy into Keychain
description:
scripts/deploy.sh sources FTP_HOST, FTP_USER, FTP_PASS and FTP_REMOTE_PATH from .env.deploy, a gitignored plain file. The machine convention (~/.claude/CREDENTIALS.md) keeps secrets in Keychain and only context in files.

Store the password with `secret set <svc> -a <user> -k password -n <panel url>` (service name like cidit-ftp), read it in the script with `security find-generic-password -s <svc> -w` (launchd-safe absolute paths not needed, the script runs from a shell), guard against an empty result, and drop FTP_PASS from .env.deploy and .env.deploy.example. Best done together with the password rotation so the new value never lands in .env.deploy. Never echo the value; print its length only.
acceptance_criteria: deploy.sh reads the password from Keychain and fails with a clear error on an empty lookup; .env.deploy and .env.deploy.example hold only host, user and remote path; a dry run and a real deploy both succeed.

title: Practicas eticas heading may break mid-word around 1024px
description:
src/projectsComponents/guarania/BoxedContent.tsx: the h3 sits in a `lg:w-1/2!` column of the promo box. A 1024px screenshot on 2026-11-18 showed "Prácticas éticas / y / medioambiental" with the rest cut off by the screenshot edge. That matches the mid-word break the new Contribuciones heading had at xl (the theme lets headings break inside words instead of overflowing), but it was not confirmed on this heading.

Confirm first: read the h3's per-line text at 1024 to 1199px. Possible fixes: keep the caption full width until xl, or step the h3 size down between lg and xl. Capture recipe for this site is in the project memory (GSAP reveal holds content at opacity 0; remove both preloaders and inline styles before screenshots).
acceptance_criteria: At 1024, 1100, 1200, 1440 and 390px the h3 'Prácticas éticas y medioambientales' wraps only at spaces (check each line's text in the DOM), with screenshots taken using the reveal-animation recipe.

title: Document the long-heading layout rule in the project instructions
description: For a long section heading, use the theme's stacked pattern (mxd-section-title__title, then __descr, then __controls) in a wide column, not the hr* row (__hrtitle / __hrdescr / __hrcontrols). The hr* title column is col-xl-4 and the theme adds padding-right 6rem at xl, so a 70px "Contribuciones científicas y técnicas" broke as "Contribuci / ones" at 1440px. Fixed in 8e10e9d with col-xl-7 / col-xl-5. Write this into AGENTS.md once the CLAUDE.md merge is done.
acceptance_criteria: The project instructions (AGENTS.md after the merge) state the rule in two or three lines, naming both class families and the reason.

title: Merge CLAUDE.md into AGENTS.md per the AGENTS.md convention
description:
The repo has a full CLAUDE.md (about 3.5 KB) and an AGENTS.md (about 850 B) that says to read docs/01 to 05 first and that docs/04_DECISIONS.md wins on conflicts. With a non-stub CLAUDE.md present, Claude Code never loads AGENTS.md, so those rules have not been in effect.

Follow ~/.claude/reference/agents-md-convention.md: reconcile the two files, commit the rename alone, then the stub in its own commit. Also add the beads pointer block: bd init ran with --skip-agents on 2026-11-18 so it would not append to the non-stub CLAUDE.md. Never run `bd setup claude`.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md holds the merged instructions (including the beads pointer block), CLAUDE.md is exactly the @AGENTS.md stub, and a fresh session in the repo shows the merged rules loaded.
